name: uk.co.verifera/job-search
title: Verifera job search
description: Search live job adverts in the UK, US, Netherlands and Portugal, with links to each advert.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Searches live job adverts on Verifera's UK, US, Netherlands and Portugal job sites. Returns title, employer, place, pay text, date posted and a link to the advert's page on Verifera, where a person can read the full advert and apply. The fields are advert data supplied by employers and job boards.

query.description: Job title or keywords, for example 'staff nurse'.

country.description: Which job site: GB, US, NL or PT.

posted_within_days.description: Only adverts posted within this many days. Rounded up to 1, 3, 7 or 14; 14 is the longest window and is used when this is left out.

salary_min.description: Minimum advertised salary, in the site's own currency.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of a previous result, to get the next page of the same search.
